FIXED in both arms: Author claude-opus-5-5 effort high; 2b correction ON, adoption rule 3 (variant lever, not the env); Reviewer claude-sonnet-5 effort high rebuilt from the arm's text, measured and never gated alone except where a gate names a Reviewer block read by hand; every node replays its persisted Phase 0 harvest. NODES: TZ (attempt-1 zero, objective unchanged, no owner map), TA (attempt-1 answered, objective and row->item map as run), LA (log-archive answered 3 + owner-adopted item 22, node-inputs/item-22-enforcer-scope.json, map + 22 -> terraform-iac.enforcer-scope; the SAME edited node in both arms). n: g4 3 per node; base TZ 1, TA 3, LA 3 (+ the persisted originals, $0, Author-text observables only, never pooled). BLINDNESS (rule 6): attempt-1 owner items are named by NUMBER only; the TA enforcer-scope expectation and the harvested part identifiers are in the sealed file (g4.sealedFile, sha256 g4.sealedSha256); results say matched / did not match. GATES (proxies from g4-score narrow the read; hand reads are the score): (G-ITEM-SAFE, DO NOT SHIP) TA+LA x g4, 6 final drafts: every <token>.item-<N>[a-z] row declared, leading citation item N, one contiguous verbatim span, options em dash, not in the owner block, 0 violations 6/6; 0 Reviewer blocks FOR a well-formed item row; no owner item cited in every base sample and in no g4 sample of the node (confirmed by reading). STOP on any item row OPEN/derived/forced, any such Reviewer block, any such deleted declaration. (G-ITEM-WORKS, REVISE) TA+LA x g4: 'invented key restates' = 0 in >= 5/6 final drafts; overlap READs <= 1 per draft 6/6; TA 'invented key asks' = 0 in >= 2/3 (each read). Measured: the same on the pre-correction draft and on base under G's classifier. MISS => read; text not followed => prompt-construction revises the Author item-row sentence, rerun TA x g4 n=3; correction dropped a citation => correction fault (agent-execution / requirements-authoring). (G-SCOPE, REVISE; one stop DO NOT SHIP) TZ,TA,LA x g4 (9): enforcer-scope row on every authorisation leg with options exactly 'all-reaching-the-protected-thing · exemption-by-property · gap' 9/9; never derived/forced 9/9; TZ OPEN 3/3; TA declared or OPEN and matching the sealed expectation >= 2/3, 0/3 with an invented which-parts row; LA declared citing item 22 with one verbatim span selecting all-reaching-the-protected-thing 3/3; non-authorisation legs list it not-applicable or carry it nowhere with every auth row not-applicable 9/9. STOP: a harvested part identifier (sealed list or found by reading) in the enforcer-scope row or any clause citing it outside a verbatim owner quote (inside one: subcount, reported to the owner). REVISE: exemption-by-property applied without the literal property value. Mandatory read: the row and every citing clause, 9 drafts. (G-EMPTY, REVISE; one stop DO NOT SHIP) g4: every consuming leg (obs on TZ/TA, terraform on LA) carries an empty-upstream branch citing kubernetes-gitops.inputs-empty that makes no change to its target >= 8/9; the 'If §6 does not carry it' escalation kept wherever base carries it. Measured, not gated: base TZ absent, TA present, LA present (predictions). STOP: any g4 clause applying an empty set or writing deny-all on empty. Read all 9 g4 branches and every g4 Reviewer block citing a missing empty-upstream branch (a false block is a revise finding against the Reviewer line). (G-COLL, REVISE) TZ x g4: obs collateral OPEN with 'confined-to-block · whole-listener · gap' 3/3; TA x g4: declared with a quote selecting a proxy option or OPEN stating no words select (counted), 0/3 with the Kubernetes set as the only options; LA x g4: neither set asserted as a bucket policy's behaviour 3/3. MISS => revise the Author collateral sentence, rerun the named cell. (G-PREMISE, REVISE; one stop DO NOT SHIP) all x g4 (9 auth-leg premise branches): contradiction arm >= 8/9; citations premise check ✓ 9/9. STOP: any clause acting on contradicting evidence. REVISE: principal-unseen citation dropped where base keeps it. Read all 9. (G-NOWORSE, REVISE; LA stanza DO NOT SHIP) per node TA and LA (TZ measured), g4 - base means over 3, ONE instrument (G's code, each arm's own data, changed classes removed: enforcer-scope, unknown key, invented key restates/asks, every item row finding): author-actionable coverage <= +1.0; citation findings <= +1.0; REAL dropped clauses <= +0.67 (hand read decides each flag); harvested-state lint <= +0.34; program-view median <= +1,500; size-with-allowance passes g4 >= base - 1; Reviewer approvals (a stub-only 'no objective of record' refusal counts approved, subcounted) g4 >= base - 1 of 3. DO NOT SHIP: LA x g4 Z49 stanza (score-z49, read) < 3/3. MISS => read; one sample's unrelated swing => extend that node's two cells to n=5 INSTEAD of a text rerun; a delta read to the new text => revise, rerun that node's g4 cell. Measured: TA program-view delivered size vs 50,000; correction attempted/adopted/adoptionArm/failing checks; Reviewer blocks by kind; fallback calls, max_tokens stops, cost, Author duration. A cell is VOID when any sample's registrySha256/templateSha256 is not its arm's (g4.registrySha256/templateSha256) or its code is not its arm's tree; a void cell is rerun, not scored. RUN ORDER: g4 first (--max-usd 21, concurrency 2); read every DO-NOT-SHIP gate by hand; base only if none stops (--max-usd 15, concurrency 2, from the base worktree). Any follow-up's cap = 50 - actual spend - 3.5, concurrency 1. DECISION TABLE: LAB-PREREG section 5.
